metric: SPES's Calcite pairs whose SQL differs from SQLSolver's wording of the same test, proved equivalent. 2 more (testSemiJoinRule, testSemiJoinRuleExists) are refuted against their equivalent label: SPES's wording drops the GROUP BY that removes duplicate DEPTNO values, so the pair genuinely differs.
caveats: SPES ships the same 232 Calcite tests as SQLSolver; 137 are textually SQLSolver's pairs and are not re-scored. Of the other 95, 61 cannot run (mostly SPES's own SQL bugs and empty VALUES) and are counted unsupported.
correctness: 0 false proofs (re-checked on 120 random DuckDB databases, half skewed towards the literals)
